description: This is a test class 'BuzzDaoAdjustCountTest' for the 'BuzzDao' class in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests verifying the adjustment of like and comment counts on social media shares and comments within the Buzz feature, including handling of purged employees.

classes.name: BuzzDaoAdjustCountTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing BuzzDao's methods that adjust like and comment counts for shares and comments within the Buzz module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by loading test fixture data from a YAML file into the database.

methods.name: testAdjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares
methods.description: Tests whether 'adjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares' correctly updates the number of likes and comments on BuzzShare entities, including handling of likes/comments by purged employees.

methods.name: testAdjustLikeCountOnComments
methods.description: Tests whether 'adjustLikeCountOnComments' correctly updates the like count on BuzzComment entities, including edge cases with purged employees.
